svg.title: GEMS Stage-One method overview
svg.desc: A clean paper-style schematic of the GEMS pipeline: train-only evidence, budgeted pruning, feature-only repair, plain MeshSplatting artifact, and pure evaluation.
svg.text: Representation-level compression and train-only repair; final artifact remains a plain MeshSplatting checkpoint.
Train-only decisions; same held-out render path. Metrics: PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, g1-g4, FPS, memory, triangles.
